name: Pink Car Shampoo Concentrate

features.text: Removes dirt and grime from all exterior vehicle surfaces.
A dense foaming-formula that rinses easily without streaks.
Suspends dirt without scratching the surface.

description: A viscous, highly concentrated product that produces a very-high-and lasting foam for use on cars, trucks, trailers, boats, and recreational vehicles.
application: DIRECTIONS: FOR BEST RESULTS, SURFACE SHOULD BE COOL AND OUT OF DIRECT SUNLIGHT. 1) Use 1 part concentrate for 300 parts water. Adjust dilution to desired strength for extremely dirty conditions. 2) Rinse vehicle exterior thoroughly. 3) Apply solution generously using a wash mitt. 4) Rinse well with clean water. 5) Wipe dry with a clean chamois or drying towel.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Foaming - 8 Concentration - 10
